_comment: Row 353. Seven exact-once regressions expand replacement backreferences, weaken either side of regex uniqueness, accept both or neither anchor key, compute length from the mutable pattern text, or postpone invalid-regex refusal until application. Each is caught by the named row-353 contract. The companion transform control applies the byte-identical M1 template-expansion transform to a behavior-free node and must ESCAPE.
subject: bd-mutate regex anchors are exclusive, exactly once, literal-replacement source rewrites

mutants.label: M1 expand regex replacement text as a backreference template
mutants.new: after = pattern.sub(new, src, count=1)  # mutant: expand groups

mutants.label: M2 permit a regex anchor that matches twice
mutants.old:
if n != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"regex anchor occurs {n} times, must be exactly 1")
mutants.new:
if n == 0:
        raise ValueError(f"regex anchor occurs {n} times, must be exactly 1")

mutants.label: M3 permit a regex anchor that matches zero times
mutants.old:
if n != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"regex anchor occurs {n} times, must be exactly 1")
mutants.new:
if n > 1:
        raise ValueError(f"regex anchor occurs {n} times, must be exactly 1")

mutants.label: M4 accept a mutant carrying both literal and regex anchors
mutants.old:
if has_old == has_old_regex:
            state = "both" if has_old else "neither"
            raise ValueError(
                f"mutant {index} must supply exactly one of 'old' or "
                f"'old_regex'; got {state}")
mutants.new:
if not has_old and not has_old_regex:
            state = "neither"
            raise ValueError(
                f"mutant {index} must supply exactly one of 'old' or "
                f"'old_regex'; got {state}")

mutants.label: M5 accept a mutant carrying neither anchor field
mutants.old:
if has_old == has_old_regex:
            state = "both" if has_old else "neither"
            raise ValueError(
                f"mutant {index} must supply exactly one of 'old' or "
                f"'old_regex'; got {state}")
mutants.new:
if has_old and has_old_regex:
            state = "both"
            raise ValueError(
                f"mutant {index} must supply exactly one of 'old' or "
                f"'old_regex'; got {state}")

mutants.label: M6 compute regex replacement length from the pattern text
M7 postpone an invalid regex until mutant application
mutants.new:
if has_old_regex:
            pass  # mutant: malformed patterns survive spec validation
